name: Swahid Kushal Konwar Sarbajanin Briddha Pension Achoni
benefit:
The beneficiary will be granted a sum of ₹ 250/- per month through DBT. 
The pension amount will be remitted on the first day of every month to the account of the beneficiary.
_eligibility_text: The scheme is meant for the residents of the State of Assam, who are 60 years or above in age.
